items.title: William Russell Interview, 1975-02-02
items.q: Woody Bruhn had recorded, uh, two years before that, the, uh, Kid Renee Band

ctx.x: I've been—not that I worry about criticism, it can't mean that much to me in any way at all, certainly not financially in any way, whether I'm criticized or not about anything. And I deserved to be criticized, certainly, about a lot of things, and I did recording because I certainly didn't know what I was doing half the time, either electrically or musically. But, um, to get back to—Jean Williams was going to come down here and record in 1942 just to see how Bunk did sound, and maybe issue the thing in the…
